static_traits.name: Lin Peiqi
static_traits.family_status: Proud of the nephew and takes on the responsibility of caring for him
static_traits.social_status: 有支持性的朋友，但尚not yet与他们分享该具体问题
static_traits.medical_history: without类似问题既往史；not yet接受过心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能具体描述问题与影响；态度消极，Self-denial明显；倾向推测他人想法并回避反馈；配合度较好，愿意尝试与侄子沟通

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直觉得自己是个糟糕的Chef，因为我做意大利菜时侄子常常吃not完；这种not足感与Continuing self-doubt数月，加上Graduate student最后一年与照顾侄子的压力，使我在为侄子做饭时感到Anxiety和not安，影响了睡眠、人际与学业。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些not足感正在影响我对烹饪的享受并导致Increased stress。

special_situations.event: 侄子在我做意大利菜时经常吃not完
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他真的喜欢我的菜，就会吃完；他吃not完就说明我的厨艺很差
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断修改食谱、向家人寻求安慰与肯定
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault，我是个坏Chef

special_situations.event: 看到侄子对饭菜显得有些not感兴趣
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要出现任何not感兴趣的表现就意味着他not喜欢我的烹饪
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses only on negative cues, ignoring family's positive evaluations

special_situations.event: Thinks about communicating with a nephew or other family members to understand the reasons
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦询问就会听到负面反馈，从而证明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids talking with nephew / family about true feelings and specific reasons
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我的菜not好、会批评我

special_situations.event: 在兼顾Graduate student学业与照顾侄子压力下为其做饭
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要我not能同时把学业和照顾侄子都做到完美，就说明我在哪方面都很糟糕
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我加压、not断调整菜谱以证明自己

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be liked and accepted through cooking, to build a warm connection with the nephew
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate与拒绝，担心自己not够好而失去关系的亲密感
defense_goal: 通过Self-denial与回避反馈来减少被批评的风险、维持表面安全感

object_relations.self_representation: Guilt, worry被negate的“not称职照料者/糟糕的Chef”
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、可能not认可自己的“被照料者（侄子）”

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to communicate with the nephew or family and collect real feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把可能的中性或正面反馈想象为批评，认为他人会negate她的厨艺（移情性推测）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气犹疑、回避具体反馈请求，use含糊表达（如“也许他只是挑食”），强调not确定性并表达紧张，暂not直接Questioning。

manifestations: 烹饪从“放松与表达爱”转变为“Anxiety来源”
与侄子的连接感下降，做饭not再带来满足

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly concerned about possible negative evaluations
做饭前后高度紧张与not安全感

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 明知可询问侄子原因却选择Repression冲动并回避沟通
尚not yet与支持性朋友分享该问题而独自承受压力
Turning the need for external feedback into self-blame and internal drain

positive_force: Passionate about cooking, willing to express love through food
Willing to try asking the nephew the reason in a relaxed way (open to reality testing)
Has a supportive network of friends
negative_force: Self-denial与过度归因于自身（个人化）
Cognitive biases such as jumping to conclusions, overgeneralization, and mental filtering
Avoiding communication for fear of negative feedback, excessively caring about others' evaluations
学业与照顾压力叠加导致Anxiety和Sleep affected

target_behavior.behavior: 在为侄子做饭时出现显著的Anxiety与not安全感
antecedent: 侄子吃not完或显得not太感兴趣的情境
Graduate student学业与照顾侄子压力并存
target_behavior.core_reason: 将侄子吃not完食物归因于自己的厨艺差，伴随个人化、跳到结论与过度概括的认知偏差
target_behavior.function: 逃避被negate与Being rejected的风险，试图通过自我批评维持控制与“预防失败”的心理安全
target_behavior.consequence: 烹饪Loss of pleasure、与侄子Relationship tension、Sleep affected、学业表现受压

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding direct communication and feedback with the nephew/family
antecedent: 想到要询问侄子not吃完的原因时
Situations of fearing negative evaluation or criticism
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被negate与羞耻感，被Projection式推测他人想法所驱动
target_behavior.function: 暂时缓解Anxiety、避免not适感与潜在冲突
target_behavior.consequence: 问题持续、误解加深、Anxiety维持并可能恶化
